title: The Impact of Leveraged and Inverse ETFs on Underlying Real Estate Returns
one_line: Six real-estate leveraged/inverse ETFs significantly moved late-day prices of their 63 component stocks, adding volatility and momentum near the close (vs control stocks).

findings.statement: Late-day price pressure and higher volatility in component stocks tied to LETF rebalancing.

reported_results.headline: Six real-estate leveraged/inverse ETFs significantly moved late-day prices of their 63 component stocks, adding volatility and momentum near the close (vs control stocks).

tradable_edge: Sector-level confirmation of the LETF close effect; no new spec (covered by letf_close_rebalance_continuation_nq and letf_flow_to_depth_last_hour_es).
data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
caveats: Only the abstract / a secondary summary was reachable (SSRN is blocked from chat sessions); numbers not verified against the full paper.
